title: Consumer Product Safety Commission SWAT raid on United Nuclear

tellings.quote: raided by the Consumer Product Safety Commission. They come in with a SWAT team with a machine woke my wife up out of bed with, you know, an M-16 pointed in her face.

plain: In the 2000s, the Consumer Product Safety Commission, the federal agency that polices dangerous products, raided the home of Bob Lazar, a man famous in UFO circles who ran a science-supply business called United Nuclear. Lazar tells it first-hand: they came "with a SWAT team" and "woke my wife up out of bed with, you know, an M-16 pointed in her face." He tells it as an example of the heavy-handed government pressure he says he has faced.
